newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina auctions $500 mln 2-yr treasury bonds.
newsitem.headline: Argentina auctions $500 mln 2-yr treasury bonds.

text.p: Argentina's Economy Ministry Tuesday auctioned $500 million in two-year bonds at a cut-off yield of 8.0 percent.
The minimum offered rate was 7.0 percent and the maximum was 8.90 percent. The bid-to-cover ratio was 3.97 times, the ministry said.
There were 125 bids amounting to $1.94 billion. The bonds were sold at par.
This was the first auction of dollar-denominated treasury bonds, or Bontes as they are called, carried out by the ministry.
The yield of 8.0 percent was within market expectations and the ministry said it represented a spread of 229 basis points over similarly dated U.S. Treasuries.
On Monday Argentina placed a two-year peso-denominated bond at par at a yield of 8.75 percent in the international markets.
